newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lindsay Manufacturing cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lindsay Manufacturing cut.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc on Thursday cut its rating for Lindsay Manufacturing Co to hold from buy based on the current share price.
-- Dain analyst J. Blair Brumley said the move is solely because the stock has performed so well, rising from 42-1/4 when the stock was first recommended on December 16.

-- Brumley said he does not know of any weakening of the fundamentals related to the company's base operations, adding that Lindsay management indicates the current levels of business are very much in line with expectations.
-- Lindsay's earnings estimates were unchanged at $3.10 a share for fiscal 1997 and $3.55 for fiscal 1998.
-- Lindsay makes irrigation systems. Its shares were trading up 1-1/4 Thursday afternoon at 53-1/2.
